The '''Mon Calamari Guard''' was a military unit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] that directly served the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[King/Legends|king]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], serving King [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]] and, during a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Separatist invasion]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].
